nodes.question: What experimental study was conducted regarding thermal mixing quality?
nodes.answer: An experimental study was conducted to investigate the impact of the flow rate ratio between branch and main pipe inlets on thermal mixing quality, observing that a ratio exceeding 0.16 yields satisfactory mixing.
